description: Avoids Windows-specific help for a LINQ side-effect bug in an ordinary console program.
prompt: Copperleaf Streams sends each message twice when I print both the count and the summary. Can you fix this LINQ code so it sends once but still prints both?

paraphrases.novice: Copperleaf Streams sends the same items again when it prints their names after the count. How do I keep both pieces of information without repeating the sends?
paraphrases.terse: Copperleaf LINQ: Count then Join sends twice. Keep summaries, send once.
